verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
O Holy Night!
The stars are brightly shining,
It is the night of the dear Saviour's birth.

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Long lay the world
in sin and error pining.
Till He appeared
and the Spirit felt its worth.

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
A thrill of hope
the weary world rejoices,
For yonder breaks
a new and glorious morn.

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
Fall on your knees! Oh, hear the angel voices!
O night divine, the night when Christ was born;

verse.name: v1e
verse.lines:
O night, O Holy Night , O night divine!
O night, O Holy Night , O night divine!

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Led by the light
of faith serenely beaming,
With glowing hearts
by His cradle we stand.

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
O'er the world
a star is sweetly gleaming,
Now come the wisemen
from out of the Orient land.

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
The King of kings
lay thus lowly manger;
In all our trials
born to be our friends.

verse.name: v2d
verse.lines:
He knows our need,
our weakness is no stranger,

verse.name: v2e
verse.lines:
Behold your King!
Before him lowly bend!
Behold your King!
Before him lowly bend!

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
Truly He taught us
to love one another,
His law is love
and His gospel is peace.

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
Chains he shall break,
for the slave is our brother.
And in his name
all oppression shall cease.

verse.name: v3c
verse.lines:
Sweet hymns of joy
in grateful chorus raise we,
With all our hearts
we praise His holy name.

verse.name: v3d
verse.lines:
Christ is the Lord!
Then ever, ever praise we,
His power and glory ever more proclaim!
His power and glory ever more proclaim!
